confidence.textual_attribution: high within the inspected passage and recorded version
confidence.case_application: conditional; requires the stated case evidence

material_claims.contrary_or_qualifying_evidence: Paragraphs 4–8 preserve applicable environmental requirements and sectoral authorizations; they do not make screening equivalent to every other authorization. The memo concerns this historical guidance, not a complete account of present law.
material_claims.permitted_use: Explain what this guidance states in the 2022–2024 record.
material_claims.prohibited_inference: A comprehensive account of current Chilean law or of every possible legal consequence.
material_claims.missing_dependency: Verify the Spanish modality and cross-references before submission. Any assertion about a later instrument or current general law requires that instrument’s independent inspection.

confidence.textual_attribution: high within the inspected passage and recorded version

material_claims.prohibited_inference: The order itself proves construction, water savings or ecological recovery.
material_claims.missing_dependency: Human legal-language review of operative provisions 1–2 is pending. A subsequent complementary RCA or implementation claim requires the corresponding original instrument or observation.

material_claims.prohibited_inference: Representative agreement, motives, or a complete assessment of a different future project.
